name: Tech Startup Lead Generation Campaign
description: Q4 2026 lead generation targeting tech startups

sources.name: Crunchbase Tech Companies
sources.prompt:
Extract all technology startup company information:
- Company name
- Founded year
- Headquarters location
- CEO/Founder names
- Website
- Contact email
- Number of employees
- Funding stage
- Latest funding amount
- Industry tags

sources.name: LinkedIn Companies (AI/SaaS)
sources.prompt:
Extract company information from LinkedIn:
- Company name
- LinkedIn company URL
- Company size (employees)
- Founded year
- Headquarters
- Website
- Company description
- Industry
- CEO name

sources.name: AngelList Startups
sources.prompt:
Extract startup information:
- Startup name
- Tagline/Description
- Website
- Location
- Founders (names)
- Funding stage
- Team size
- Contact email

sources.name: YCombinator Companies
sources.prompt:
Extract Y Combinator startup information:
- Company name
- Batch (cohort)
- Tagline
- Website
- Location
- Founder names
- Industry focus
- Hiring information

sources.name: GitHub Trending
sources.prompt:
Extract trending project information:
- Project name
- Description
- Repository URL
- Creator/Organization
- Language
- Stars
- Contact email (if available)
- Related websites

sources.name: Product Hunt Launches
sources.prompt:
Extract product and company information:
- Product name
- Company/Maker name
- Description
- Website
- Maker website/email
- Product categories
- Tagline
- Upvotes

sources.name: Business Directory
sources.prompt:
Extract business directory listings:
- Business name
- Business type
- Website
- Phone
- Email
- Address
- Business description
- Owner/Manager name
